admin.specialistsSubtitle: Visa specialist accounts on the platform
admin.newSpecialistHint: You'll get a temporary password for the specialist. They replace it with their own at first sign-in.

admin.confirmReset: Issue a new temporary password to {{email}}? The old one stops working, and the specialist will have to set up two-factor sign-in again.
admin.issuedText: Give the password for {{email}} in person or in a messaging app.
admin.issuedWarning: The password is shown only once. If it gets lost, issue a new one.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.account_disabled: This account is blocked. Contact the administrator.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.
errors.code_sent_recently: A code was just sent. You can ask for a new one in a minute.
errors.code_expired: The code has expired or was entered wrong too many times. Ask for a new one.
errors.mail_unavailable: Sending email is not set up yet. Contact the administrator.
errors.mail_failed: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
errors.phone_invalid: The number needs 8 to 15 digits, country code included.
errors.invalid_period: The period can be 10 years at most.
errors.outcome_required: Enter the visa outcome first: without it the case cannot move to «Result».
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.request_too_large: The request is too large. If you are uploading a file, make it smaller.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for VisaCRM.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved during setup. Each code works once.
twoFactor.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code
twoFactor.useApp: Use a code from the app
twoFactor.setupIntro: This is up to you. With two-factor sign-in a password alone isn't enough: you also need a code from an app on your phone. Setup takes a minute.
twoFactor.passwordHint: To connect an app, enter your VisaCRM password.
twoFactor.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or another.
twoFactor.stepScan: In the app, add an account and scan the QR code.
twoFactor.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter the key manually:
twoFactor.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
errors.login_expired: Time to enter the code has run out. Please sign in again.
errors.two_factor_setup_not_started: Reload the page and scan the QR code again.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitleAdmin: All events on the platform, by workspace, user and action. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.subtitleWorkspace: What you and your employees did: logins and changes in the workspace. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.
audit.reason.email_change_password: wrong password when changing the email
audit.reason.password_change_password: wrong current password when changing the password
audit.reason.two_factor_setup_password: wrong password when turning on two-factor sign-in
audit.reason.two_factor_disable_password: wrong password when turning off two-factor sign-in
audit.reason.two_factor_disable_code: wrong code when turning off two-factor sign-in
admin.modulesHint: The specialist works only with the modules turned on here and can give employees only these. Modules of later stages start working once they are built.
employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Assistants you open part of the workspace to. Each sees only the sections given to them.
employees.newHint: You'll get a temporary password for the employee. They replace it with their own on first sign-in.
employees.modulesHint: You can give only the sections enabled for you.
employees.confirmBlock: Block {{email}}? The employee is signed out at once.
employees.confirmReset: Issue a new temporary password to {{email}}? The old one stops working and two-factor sign-in is reset.
employees.casesHint: An employee sees the cases you tick in the case itself (the «Employee access» block) and the other cases of the same submission groups. They also see the clients they added themselves.
employees.limitsHint: How many different client cards and cases the employee may open in a day and how many vault passwords they may show. Once the limit is reached they wait until the next day, and you see it in «Needs attention». Every open is written to the log.
revealed.title: Passwords {{email}} revealed
revealed.hint: Vault passwords the employee showed or copied. When the employee leaves, change the ones not changed yet: first on the site the password is for, then in the vault.
revealed.hintBlocked: The employee is blocked. Change the passwords they saw that are not changed yet: first on the site the password is for, then in the vault.
revealed.none: The employee has not revealed any password.
errors.module_not_available: This section is not enabled for you, so it cannot be given to an employee.
settings.title: My account
settings.subtitle: Login email, style and language apply to your account only.
settings.emailHint: A code goes to the new address. Once you enter it here, the email changes. The old address gets a notice, and you'll need to sign in again on other devices.
settings.codeSent: The code was sent to {{email}}. It is valid until {{time}}.
settings.emailChanged: Email changed. The old address got a notice.
settings.themeHint: The style you pick shows on all your devices.
theme.blue.name: Business blue
theme.blue.about: Light cards and a dark menu.
theme.dark.name: Dark
theme.dark.about: Dark background and a mint accent, easier on the eyes at night.
theme.warm.name: Warm
theme.warm.about: Warm tones, round buttons, serif headings.
theme.minimal.name: Minimal
theme.minimal.about: White background, black accent, thin lines.
reference.title: Countries and operators
reference.subtitleAdmin: The platform's shared reference: countries, visa center operators and shared checklists. Specialists set up their directions and cities themselves.
reference.countriesHint: Visa countries and submission countries. A switched-off country disappears from specialists' lists but stays in old cases.
reference.codeHint: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, for example PL or GB.
reference.operatorCodeHint: System code: lowercase Latin letters, digits and _, for example vfs. It cannot be changed later.
errors.country_code_taken: A country with this code already exists.
errors.operator_code_taken: An operator with this code already exists.
errors.rule_exists: A rule for this pair of countries already exists.
errors.window_days_required: For an application with a window, enter the window in days.
errors.rule_in_use: Cases use this direction, so it can only be switched off.
errors.visa_center_in_use: Cases name this city, so it can only be switched off.
errors.registrar_in_use: This registrar has cases or payments, so it can only be switched off.
errors.partner_in_use: Client cards name this partner, so it can only be switched off.
dict.title: Lists
dict.subtitle: Your lists for client files and cases: visa purposes, channels, partners, registrars, prepayments, systems and passwords for the vault, currencies.
dict.purposesHint: Each purpose has its own queue at the visa center. You can switch off a purpose you no longer use, and old cases will keep it.
dict.channelsHint: Where clients come from. Analytics counts the funnel and profit per channel.
dict.name: Name
dict.partnersHint: People who bring clients for a fee. Their terms are filled into a case by country and can be changed there.
dict.confirmDeletePartner: Delete the partner “{{name}}”? Its terms go with it.
dict.partnerInUseSwitchOff: Client cards name this partner, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off? It will disappear from the lists, and the clients and their cases will keep it.
dict.terms.title: Terms
dict.termsHint: The «All countries» row applies when a country has no terms of its own. A percent is of the whole service price, with no deductions. «Not tracked» means no payout is computed or stored.
dict.registrarsHint: People who put clients in a queue for a fee. The fee depends on the country, visa purpose and hall, and a case takes it from the fee list.
dict.confirmDeleteRegistrar: Delete the registrar “{{name}}”? Its fee list goes with it.
dict.registrarInUseSwitchOff: This registrar has cases or payments, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off? It will disappear from the lists, and its cases and settlements will stay.
dict.pricesHint: One fee per country, visa purpose and hall. «Any purpose» applies when a purpose has no fee of its own.
dict.prepaymentsHint: A fixed prepayment per country and visa purpose, in the currency you name it in. It is filled into a case's finances in the case's currency at the National Bank rate and can be changed there.
dict.source.nbrb: The latest National Bank rate, updated automatically. You can correct it in a payment.
dict.vaultSystemsHint: Sites you create accounts on, and each site's password requirements. The vault's generator follows them.
dict.passwordRulesHint: Set what the site asks for: the password length and the characters it must have. Every password gets at least one character of each ticked kind.
dict.passwordSymbolsHint: The ones the site accepts. Leave empty for no special characters.
errors.booking_dates_kind: A hotel has a free cancellation date, a flight booking a validity date.
errors.dates_order: The end date is before the start date.
errors.document_date_needs_present: A document date is given only when the document is there.
errors.document_date_in_future: A document date cannot be later than today.
errors.account_of_another_contact: This account belongs to another client.
errors.no_password: No password is saved for this account.
errors.case_of_another_contact: This case belongs to another client.
errors.password_rules_empty: Tick at least one kind of character or list the special characters.
errors.duplicate_entry: The list has identical rows. Keep one.
contacts.title: Clients
contacts.subtitle: Contacts, consultations and cases in one place
contacts.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, Telegram, visa centre number or login
contacts.empty: No clients yet. Add the first one.
contacts.nameHint: A surname or a first name is enough.
contacts.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +375 29 123-45-67. A Belarusian number can also be typed the local way: 8 029 123-45-67. You can't add a second file with the same phone.
contacts.telegramHint: Username, profile link or the name in Telegram.
contacts.messengerContact: Number or username in the messenger
contacts.confirmDeleteCard: Delete the file «{{name}}»? Its entries in the audit log stay. It cannot be restored.
contacts.confirmDeleteCardWith: Delete the file «{{name}}»? These go with it: {{items}}. Its entries in the audit log stay. It cannot be restored.
contacts.documentsHint: PDF or a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), up to 10 MB. Files are stored encrypted; every download is written to the log.
contacts.documentsOff: Consent and contract files can be attached once file storage is connected.
contacts.confirmDeleteDocument: Delete the file «{{name}}»? It cannot be restored.
contacts.noRelations: No links yet. This is where you note family and who brought whom.
contacts.whoIsWho: Who are they to each other?
contacts.whoIsWhoHint: Under each name, write who that person is to the other, for example mother and daughter.
contacts.familyCaseHint: To file a family together, press «+ New case» and tick everyone who is going. You choose the country, purpose and place of submission once for all of them.
contacts.notePlaceholder: What you discussed, what was decided, what to do next
errors.phone_taken: A client with this phone already exists.
errors.telegram_taken: A client with this Telegram already exists. If it is the same person, open their file. If the account is shared, by a family for example, save anyway.
errors.contact_has_history: A client file with cases, a paid consultation, vault accounts, files, trips or templates cannot be deleted.
errors.name_required: Enter a surname or a first name.
errors.self_link: A client cannot be linked to themselves.
errors.unknown_employee: There is no such employee in your workspace.
errors.document_too_large: The file is over 10 MB. Compress it or split it into parts.
errors.document_type_not_allowed: Only PDF and photos are accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC.
errors.too_many_documents: This client already has 50 files. Delete the ones you don't need to add a new one.
errors.documents_storage_full: Client files have taken all 10 GB set aside for the workspace. Delete the ones you don't need to add a new one.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is not set up yet. Contact the administrator.
errors.storage_failed: File storage did not respond. Try again later.
errors.card_limit_reached: Today's card limit is used up. Cards opened today still open; new ones open tomorrow or once the specialist raises the limit.
errors.password_limit_reached: Today's password limit is used up. New passwords can be shown tomorrow or once the specialist raises the limit.
errors.mrz_not_found: There are no MRZ lines in the text. A passport has two lines of 44 characters, an ID card three of 30.
audit.action.contacts.viewed: Client file viewed by an employee
reference.passportRuleValue: issued ≤ {{years}} years ago, +{{months}} months after the trip
reference.passportHint: The questionnaire check uses these passport rules. For Schengen the passport must be issued within the last 10 years and stay valid 3 more months after departure. If a field is empty, that rule is not checked.
reference.schengenHint: From this date days in the country count towards the 90/180 rule. If the field is empty, the country is not in the Schengen area (like Cyprus and Ireland).
contacts.hint.passport_expired: The passport has expired — a new one is needed.
contacts.hint.passport_too_old: {{country}}: by the trip date the passport will be older than allowed.
contacts.hint.passport_expires_too_soon: {{country}}: the passport expires too soon after the trip.
contacts.hint.refusal_before: {{country}}: there was a refusal for this country before — keep it in mind.
contacts.hint.invitation_relatives: {{country}}: relatives or friends live there — a visa by invitation is possible.
contacts.hint.invitation_humanitarian: {{country}}: a childhood humanitarian trip — a visa by invitation is possible.
contacts.followUpHint: When the client promised to answer. On that day the CRM will remind you to ask for the decision.
contacts.feeHint: The consultation fee counts towards the price whenever the client comes back.
contacts.passportFormHint: Details from the passport's data page are needed for visa forms. You can fill them in later.
contacts.passportEmpty: No passport data yet. Add it with «Edit».
mrz.title: Scan a passport
mrz.hint: Upload a photo or scan of the photo page with the bottom lines containing «<<<» visible. The photo is read right in the browser, is not sent anywhere and is not kept. Only those lines go to the server to be checked.
mrz.notFound: No MRZ lines were found in the photo. Retake it straight and without glare so the bottom lines fit in whole, or type them in.
mrz.photoUnreadable: The file does not open as a photo. Save it as JPEG or PNG (on iPhone, the «Most Compatible» format).
mrz.linesHint: You can type or paste them, for example by copying the text from the photo on your phone.
mrz.invalid: The check digits do not agree: {{fields}}. Compare the lines with the passport and correct them.
mrz.corrected: A look-alike character in the passport number was fixed by its check digit. Compare the number with the passport.
errors.currency_not_accepted: This currency is not turned on in Lists → Currencies and tax.

cases.empty: No cases yet. A case is one visa for one applicant. Open it from a consultation with «Create case».
caseBlocks.financeSaved: Price and terms of case {{case}} saved
cases.appealNotAccepted: This consulate does not accept appeals
cases.appealDeadlineUnknown: Accepted, but the deadline isn't in the reference
cases.appealUnknown: Not known whether appeals are accepted

caseAccess.hint: An employee sees only the ticked cases and their clients' cards.
caseAccess.hintGroup: The employee also sees the other cases of the submission group with their clients' cards.
caseAccess.noModules: without the Clients and Cases sections the case will not open
package.title: Documents
package.noChecklist: There is no checklist for this case's country and purpose. You can add items on the page
package.onSubmission: Document freshness is counted as of the submission date, {{date}}
package.onToday: No submission date yet, so document freshness is counted as of today
package.maxAge_one: no older than {{count}} day at submission
package.maxAge_other: no older than {{count}} days at submission
cases.noCandidates: Linked contacts have no cases to add. Link the contacts in «Family and links» first.
cases.confirmLeave: Remove this case from the submission group?
cases.applyToGroup: The same for the whole group: {{names}}
cases.applyToGroupHint: Their country, place of submission, purpose, registrar and hall, submission date and questionnaire deadline change too. Cases that already have a result are not changed. This box does not copy the visa result: that has a box of its own, shown once you choose the outcome.
cases.resultToGroup: The same result for everyone in the group: {{names}}
cases.resultToGroupHint: The outcome, decision date and visa details go into their cases, and those cases move to «Result». Cases that already have a result are not changed.
cases.noCities: This direction has no cities yet.
cases.noRule: No direction is set up for this pair of countries.
cases.confirmDelete: Delete case #{{number}}? It cannot be restored.
cases.confirmDeleteWith: Delete case #{{number}}? These go with it: {{items}}. It cannot be restored.
cases.deleteLeavesGroup: The other cases of the submission group stay; this one just leaves it.
cases.keptByMoney: Case №{{number}} cannot be deleted while it holds money: {{items}}. Remove it in the case's finances, then delete the case.
cases.keptBy.partner_paid: the partner payout (clear the «Paid to the partner on» date)
errors.case_has_money: The case has payments, expenses, a registrar talon or a partner payout marked as paid. Remove them in the case's finances first, then delete the case.
cases.applicantsHintConsultation: Applicants at the consultation: {{planned}}, selected: {{count}}. Each gets their own case, and several cases form a submission group.
cases.applicantsHint: Each applicant gets their own case, and several cases form a submission group.
cases.resultNeedsOutcome: To move the case to «Result», choose the visa outcome and save.
errors.same_country: The visa country and the submission country are the same.
errors.visa_center_mismatch: This submission city does not belong to the chosen countries. Pick the city again.
errors.duplicate_applicant: The same person is selected twice.
errors.in_another_group: Both cases are already in different submission groups. Take one out of its group first.
audit.action.cases.grouped: Case added to a submission group
audit.action.cases.ungrouped: Case taken out of a submission group
audit.action.cases.access_updated: Employee access to a case changed
index.sort.label: Order
cases.applicantsNotTheVisitor: The person who came to the consultation doesn't have to be an applicant. If the case is for someone else, untick them and add the applicant.
cases.caseInWork: {{name}} already has a case in work: #{{number}} {{country}}.
errors.case_in_work: The applicant already has a case in work. Open it on the client's card.
index.boardHint: Drag a card to another column to change its stage; you will be asked before it moves. A family in one column moves together. A case without a visa outcome does not move to «Result»: its form opens so you can enter it. Drag a client from «Consultation» to any stage to open a case: the client's card opens with the case form. On a phone, change the stage on the client's card. «Result» shows decisions of the last month. Above the board you can pick half a year, a year, all time or your own dates: press «Dates». «Consultation» shows clients without a case in work from the last 3 months.
index.confirmOpenCase: Open a case for «{{name}}»? The client's card will open with the case form.
index.confirmResult: A case moves to «Result» with its visa outcome. Open the card of «{{name}}» to enter it?
queues.title: Queues and appointments
queues.subtitle: Who is in a queue, since when, through which registrar and under what number. Applications with a window and their deadlines are here too.
queues.empty: Nobody is in a queue yet. Put a client in the queue or send an application from their case.
queues.nobodyHere: Nobody is waiting for this country now.
queues.showClosed: Show those taken off and submitted
queues.averageWait: Average wait of your clients for this country, city and purpose: {{count}} days.
queues.removedLine: Taken off: waited from {{from}} to {{to}}, days: {{count}}
queues.sameLetterFor: The same date and appointment for group members
queues.fillGroup: Fill in the number and email for group members who have none
queues.newAccountHint: For attempt №{{number}} the visa centre opens a new account: add it to the client's vault.
errors.already_queued: This case is already in the queue.
errors.attempt_open: The previous application is still open. Wait for a date or for its deadline, or cancel it.
errors.no_window: There is no application with a window for this pair of countries in the reference.
vault.title: Account vault
vault.empty: No accounts yet. Logins for visa center, embassy and email sites are kept here, and their passwords are encrypted.
vault.logged: A password is shown on request and hides after 30 seconds. Every showing and copying goes to the audit log.
vault.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the current password.
vault.confirmDelete: Delete the account from the vault? Its password cannot be restored.
vault.pageSubtitle: Your own accounts (backup mailboxes, Booking) and the client accounts created on each mailbox. Clients' accounts are kept on their cards.
vault.ownEmpty: No accounts of your own yet. Add your backup mailboxes, and you'll be able to pick them on a client's card.
bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.empty: No bookings. Add hotels with their free cancellation date and the client's flight booking here. You'll get reminders about the dates until the case has its result.
bookings.cancelOnClose: The case is closed but {{count}} bookings are still active. Cancel them to avoid charges.
bookings.confirmDelete: Delete the booking? If it was cancelled, press «Mark cancelled» instead, so it stays in the history.
bookings.warning.case_closed: The case is closed — cancel the booking.
bookings.warning.expires_before_submissi: The flight booking ends before the submission date.
bookings.pageSubtitle: Active bookings of all clients. First come those whose free cancellation or flight booking ends soonest.
bookings.noneSoon: No deadlines in the next {{count}} days.
env.staging: Test site: all data is made up and no email is actually sent. Don't enter real client data.
errors.rate_unavailable: The site has no National Bank rate for this currency yet. Enter the rate by hand.
errors.registrar_fee_incomplete: Give both the amount and the currency of the registrar fee.
errors.partner_terms_incomplete: These partner terms need a percent or an amount.
finance.heading: Finances
finance.priceCurrencyHint: The prepayment, consultation credit and balance are in it too. Tax and profit are in {{base}}.
finance.taxNotSetHint: Set the rate on the «My account» page → «Accounting currency and tax». If you pay no tax, enter 0.
finance.rateHint: This is the site's latest National Bank rate. You can correct it.
finance.rateMissing: The site has no rate for this currency yet, so enter it by hand.
finance.expenseHint: An expense is what the specialist pays for themselves. The client books and pays for the flight reservation, so it doesn't go here.
registrars.title: Registrar settlements
registrars.subtitle: Payments to registrars and the talons of the clients they queued. The balance is in the registrar's currency.
registrars.none: No registrars yet. Add them in «Lists».
registrars.low: Time to top up the advance
registrars.threshold: Reminder when the advance is below {{amount}} {{currency}}
registrars.noThreshold: No reminder threshold is set. You can set one in the registrars list.
registrars.missingHint: This registrar's cases with no talon in their finances. A talon is charged at the price-list price on the day the client was queued.
registrars.noPrice: No price in the price list — enter the talon in the case finances
registrars.otherCurrencyHint: These talons are not in the balance because their currency differs from the settlement currency ({{currency}}). Fix the talon in the case finances or the settlement currency in the registrars list.
dict.settlementsHint: The balance with the registrar (advance or debt) is kept in this currency. Talons in another currency are not counted.
dict.lowBalance: Remind when the advance is below, {{currency}}
finance.talonSettledField: Already paid to the registrar before the CRM, so it stays out of the settlements
errors.talon_exists: This case already has a talon.
errors.no_registrar_price: The registrar's price list has no price for this country, purpose and hall.
errors.registrar_mismatch: This case is handled by another registrar.
audit.action.finances.talon_charged: Talon charged from the price list
settings.twoFactorOn: On. Besides the password, sign-in needs a code from the authenticator app.
settings.twoFactorOff: Off, so the password alone signs you in. Turn it on and sign-in will also need a code from an app on your phone.
settings.twoFactorTurnOffHint: To turn it off, enter your password and a code from the app or one of the recovery codes.
settings.eraseHint: If you are moving to another system, you can delete everything you kept in the CRM here: clients, cases, consultations, payments, vault passwords, files, bookings, queues, directions, document templates and employees. Your sign-in, settings, subscription and activity log stay.
settings.eraseNeedsTwoFactor: Data can be deleted only with two-factor sign-in on. Turn it on in the section above.
settings.eraseWarning: Deleted data cannot be brought back, so save what you will need in the new system first. The platform's backups keep the data for up to 12 months, then it is wiped automatically.
settings.eraseConfirm: I understand that all the workspace's data will be deleted for good
settings.erased: All the workspace's data has been deleted.

home.funnelHint: The month's consultations and how far their clients got. Percentages are of the consultations.
home.noQueues: Nobody is waiting for an appointment.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Everything is counted from your client cards, so no more summary tables by hand
analytics.kpi.profitNote: of cases submitted in the period
analytics.channelsHint: Consultations in the period and what became of their clients: how many went to work, how many got a visa and what it brought.
analytics.monthsHint: Consultations go to the month they took place, and submissions, visas and profit to the month of submission.
analytics.countriesHint: Approval is counted by country because the consulate makes the decision.
analytics.resultsHint: Visa types, refusals, appeals, and those who had a date but did not go.
analytics.centersHint: Appointments and timing depend on the center. Here you see the wait for a letter or how many applications it takes to get a date, the review time and your remarks.

import.title: Spreadsheet import
import.subtitle: Any AI can turn your spreadsheets into the VisaCRM format with a ready-made prompt. You first see the client cards from the file, and they are added to your clients only after you confirm
import.prepareTemplate: Download the template. It has the format's sheets and your lists: countries, channels, registrars, vault systems.
import.preparePrompt: Open an AI that takes files and runs code (for example, ChatGPT or Claude) and paste the prompt.
import.prepareFiles: Attach your spreadsheets and the template. The AI asks how to work, reviews the sheets and asks its questions, then builds the file.
import.privacy: If the AI gets whole spreadsheets, your clients' data goes to the company behind it, often outside Belarus and the EU. If your clients have not agreed to that, choose the mode in which the AI sees only the headers and writes a script for Google Sheets.
import.fileHint: XLSX up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows. The file waits on the server until you confirm or cancel loading it, at most a day. Nothing goes into your clients before you confirm.
import.fileHolds: Sheets: {{sheets}}, clients: {{clients}}. Nothing has been added to your clients yet.
import.sampleNote: This is how the file's first clients will look in the CRM. If everything is right, process the whole file. If something is off, cancel, fix the file with the AI and upload it again.
import.sampleRight: All right — process the whole file
import.sampleEmpty: The file has no clients, so there is nothing to show.
import.progressHint: The file is being processed on the server. You can minimise the browser, and the progress will update when you come back.
import.stopped: A newer run, started later, replaced this one.
import.runningSample: Making the sample cards of the file «{{file}}»
import.checkNote: Nothing has been added to your clients yet. Below is what will change once you confirm.
import.cardsNote: Open any card and check it. «New» — the client is not in the CRM yet, «will change» — the file adds or changes records on the card, «unchanged» — everything is already there.
import.confirmHint: Loading the same file again makes no duplicates.
import.choicesChanged: You changed the choices for unknown values. Press "Check again" and the cards will show the file with the new choices.
import.copyReportHint: Paste the report into the same chat and the AI will fix the file. The report has no client data, only sheets, rows and columns.
import.reportForAi: The VisaCRM check report of the file "{{file}}". Fix the file according to it and do not change the row codes.
import.passwordsMoved_one: {{count}} password moved to the vault. Now delete the passwords from Google Sheets and the import file itself: it holds client data.
import.passwordsMoved_other: {{count}} passwords moved to the vault. Now delete the passwords from Google Sheets and the import file itself: it holds client data.
import.nothingChanges: Nothing will change: everything in the file is already in the CRM.
import.moreIssues: And {{count}} more — the report keeps the first 1000

stay.pageSubtitle: How many days a person may spend in the Schengen area given past trips, and whether a planned trip fits.
stay.tripsHint: Enter the Schengen trips of the last six months and the days are counted for you. The country is needed to tell Schengen from the rest.
stay.rowIncomplete: Pick a country and an entry date so the trip is counted.
stay.empty: No trips. Add trips to Schengen to count the days under the 90/180 rule and check a planned trip.
stay.exitHint: With no exit date the person is still there, and days are counted up to today.
stay.longStay: Under a D visa or a residence permit — do not count
stay.windowHint: {{free}} days are free now, but the stay may be longer because the 180-day period moves on every day and old trips drop out of it.
stay.overstayNow: the limit is already exceeded, time to leave
stay.overstay: 90/180 exceeded: {{first}} – {{last}} ({{count}} days). The consulate may take it into account in a new application.
stay.longStayChip: D visa or permit — not counted
stay.checkHint: When does the person plan to enter? Give the dates and we will check whether the trip fits the rule.
stay.usedBefore: In the 180 days before entry — {{used}} of {{max}} days
stay.cannotEnter: No entry on {{date}}: the limit is used up
stay.fitsFrom: A {{count}}-day trip fits when entering from {{date}}
stay.tooLong: A short-stay visa does not allow more than {{max}} days in a row
stay.rule: The rule: no more than 90 days in any 180, and the days of entry and exit both count. Only Schengen countries count; days under a D visa or a residence permit don't. The count follows the dates entered.
stay.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved here; a client's trips are kept in their card.
errors.trip_too_far: Dates more than two years ahead are not counted.
errors.trip_exit_required: Give a planned trip its exit date.
errors.trip_too_long: The trip is longer than a year. If the person lived there under a D visa or a residence permit, tick that.
errors.unknown_country: There is no such country in the reference.
dict.purposeKindHint: The kind decides which shared checklist items a case gets: an invitation, say, for a visit to family or friends. With no kind, a case gets only the items for any purpose.
checklists.title: Document checklists
checklists.subtitle: What to collect for a visa to a country: the shared list and your own items
checklists.submissionHint: Needed only when applying in this country, such as a residence permit there
checklists.filteredHint: Only the items for a case with this submission country and purpose are shown. The package check uses exactly these.
checklists.pickCountry: Choose a country to see its list.
checklists.sharedEmpty: There is no shared list for this country yet.
checklists.ownEmpty: No items of your own. Add what the shared list lacks.
checklists.noneForCase: No items for a case like this.
checklists.name: Document
checklists.maxAgeHint: Counted on the submission day. Leave empty for no limit
checklists.purposesHint: If nothing is ticked, the item applies to any purpose.
checklists.noteHint: For example: on a letterhead, stamped; for the employed
checklists.hint: The admin keeps the shared list; it is the same for every specialist. Items for visiting, business and other purposes go by the purpose kind, which is set in Lists → Visa purposes.
checklists.adminHint: Every specialist with the «Package check» module sees a country's shared list and adds their own items to it. An item can't be deleted, only switched off, because cases refer to it.
errors.order_mismatch: The list has changed. Reload the page.
templates.title: Document templates
templates.subtitle: Your Word files with codes. The codes are replaced with the client's data, and the file is named for the client
templates.storageOff: Templates can be uploaded once file storage is connected.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Take one of your documents, put codes into it following the steps below and upload the file.
templates.emptyEmployee: No templates yet. The specialist uploads them.
templates.fileHint: Up to 5 MB. To save a Google Doc: File → Download → Microsoft Word (.docx).
templates.name: Name
templates.nameHint: What the template is called in the list. If left empty, the file's name is used.
templates.fileNameHint: Codes are allowed. If left empty, it will be «Name — client's full name».
templates.unknownHint: Check the spelling against the code table and replace the file. Until then such codes stay in the document as they are.
templates.confirmDeleteUsed_one: {{count}} client has the template «{{name}}» — it will go from their card too. Delete? To just stop offering it to new clients, switch the template off.
templates.confirmDeleteUsed_other: {{count}} clients have the template «{{name}}» — it will go from their cards too. Delete? To just stop offering it to new clients, switch the template off.
templates.howTo.title: How to make a template
templates.howTo.write: Open your document in Word or Google Docs: a sponsor letter, a statement, a cover letter, a power of attorney, a contract.
templates.howTo.codes: Where the client's data goes, write a code in double curly braces, e.g. «I, {{Full name}}, born {{Date of birth}}». All the codes are in the table below: tap one to copy it.
templates.howTo.upload: Press «Upload a template» on this page. You'll see which codes were found in the file and, separately, the unknown ones, which are usually typos.
templates.howTo.give: In the client's card, in «Documents from templates», press «Add» and choose the template and the case the document is for.
templates.howTo.download: Press the document in the card, and the file downloads with the client's data, named for the client. The data is taken at the moment of download, so after you fix the card, download it again.
templates.rules.title: Rules
templates.rules.anyCase: Case, spaces and underscores do not matter: {{Full name}}, {{full name}} and {{ full_name }} are one code.
templates.rules.language: A code can be written in Russian or in English. The code's language is the value's language: {{Гражданство}} gives «Беларусь», {{Nationality}} gives «Belarus». Sums follow the language too.
templates.rules.grammar: Countries, purposes and other values go in as they are, in their basic form: in Russian text write «Страна поездки: {{Страна визы}}» rather than «поездка в {{Страна визы}}», which needs another case ending.
templates.rules.format: The value takes the code's formatting: font, size, bold. Format the whole code, and the value will look the same.
templates.rules.where: Codes work in text, tables, headers and footers, footnotes and text boxes. A code must sit within one paragraph, without a line break.
templates.rules.empty: If something is not filled in for the client, the code's place stays empty. The card shows in advance what is missing.
templates.rules.unknown: An unknown code stays in the document as written, so a typo is seen at once. Dates are written as 05.10.1990.
templates.codesHint: Tap a code to copy it, then paste it into the document.
templates.code.full_name: Full name, as in the card
templates.code.full_name_latin: Name in Latin letters, as in the passport
templates.code.last_name_latin: Surname in Latin letters, as in the passport
templates.code.first_name_latin: Given names in Latin letters, as in the passport
templates.code.purpose: Purpose of the trip, as in your «Lists»
templates.code.price: Price of the service, from the case's finances

directions.title: Directions and cities
directions.subtitle: Where your clients apply to and from, how booking works and in which cities. Cases, queues, windowed applications and reminders follow these settings.
directions.empty: No directions yet. Press «+ Direction» and pick the destinations, the submission country, how booking works and the cities. Several countries booked the same way can be set up in one form.
directions.emptyReader: No directions yet. The specialist sets them up.
directions.readerHint: The specialist sets up the directions.
directions.takenFrom: {{country}} is already set up with submission from: {{submissions}}. Choose another submission country.
directions.takenEverywhere: {{country}} is already set up with submission from every country. A new direction cannot be added; change one of the existing ones.
directions.bookingHint.waiting_list: The client is put in a queue; the letter with a date comes later.
directions.bookingHint.windowed_applicat: The application waits for a letter a set number of days, then is sent again.
directions.bookingHint.direct_slot: A slot is caught on the visa center's site when slots are released.
directions.bookingHint.embassy: Booking or applying directly with the embassy.
directions.citiesHint: Type a city and press Enter. Each city has its own queue.
directions.cityInUse: This city is used in cases. Switch it off? New cases won't be able to pick it, and old ones will keep it.
directions.inUseSwitchOff: Cases use this direction, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off? It will disappear from the lists, and cases will keep their settings.

subscription.ownHint: You pay for the CRM outside the system, and the administrator marks your payments.
subscription.overdueBanner: Your subscription payment is {{days}} d overdue.

errors.tariff_inactive: The tariff is inactive, so it can't be given to a new specialist.

errors.no_subscription: The specialist has no tariff; give them one first.

import.pricesIn: Prices from the file will be in {{currency}}, your accounting currency.
